# Inventory tracker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/inventory-tracker/

Maintain a small inventory table with SKU, quantity, unit cost and reorder level, with explicit local saving and CSV/JSON exports.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Record ten products, subtract a sale quantity and review which items reached their reorder point.

## Limits and checks

This is a single-browser manual tracker, not a shared inventory service. Export backups; browser storage can be cleared and does not synchronize across devices.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
